Asha: Scheduling planned maintenance in eu-west1 Tue 02:00-03:15 UTC. Scope: GPU driver micro-release + fan sensor firmware alignment. We'll do rolling drains in 10m rack cohorts, max 3 racks offline.
Ravi: Which pools impacted and are any Dedicated tenants pinned?
Asha: Pools: eu-main (r1-r6), eu-burst (r7-r10). No high-priority pins on r1-r3 (first cohort). Dedicated traffic will failover to eu-fallback.
Sam: Cost note: spill to fallback may hit reserved commit. Finance estimated ~€110 for the window.
Asha: We'll limit KV preseed to two canary nodes to avoid token burn.
Ravi: Rollback plan?
Asha: Revert driver, cold reboot GPU, remove from maintenance. If rollback fails, route to fallback and open incident.
Marta: ops-bot, schedule job and attach runbook?
ops-bot: Job scheduled 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z-2026-04-07T03:15:00Z. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/eu-west-gpu-sync. Notifying oncall.
Sam: Validation thresholds: p95 latency > 1.2s or KV regen > 700ms -> abort. Also watch egress drops >0.5%.
Ravi: Paste cordon/drain snippet pls.
Asha: Snippet: kubectl cordon $NODE ; kubectl drain $NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=600s ; update firmware ; kubectl uncordon $NODE
Marta: Adding telemetry tag maintenance_id=eu-fw-sync-1789993210.
Asha: Final checklist: customer comms 24h/2h, ops-bot job, network throttle plan + ramp-down, limited KV preseed, finance notified, oncall set. Post status updates here during the run. :thumbsup:
